newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds and Reynolds sees Q4 charges.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds and Reynolds sees Q4 charges.

text.p: Reynolds and Reynolds Co said on Tuesday that it would post charges between $18 million and $25 million during the fourth quarter ending September 30, 1997.
The charges are related to closing certain manufacturing and distribution facilities and streamlining other functions, the company said in a statement.
Reynolds and Reynolds is closing facilities in Dayton, Ohio, Salt Lake City and Winsted, Conn., it said.
A Reynolds and Reynolds spokesman said 240 employees will be laid off by the company's move to close the business form manufacturing facilities.
A small number of workers will be offered jobs at other plants, but that number has not yet been determined, a spokesman said.
The charge would cover the writedown of assets and severance packages, the spokesman said.
The company expects to close the Salt Lake City facility in October, Windsted in November and Dayton in December.
The work at those facilities is being consolidated into the company's 24 other plants, the spokesman said.
